ratings.note: Every slot; but the intro and Opening days panel state slots last 20 minutes, so only end time and arrival rule are lost; low impact.
Only after hold expiry; screenshot shows Change slot link directly in the Slot row below the alert and details kept, so recovery is visible though not named.
Every car booking (screenshot: permit field shown with no vehicle chosen); hesitation/confusion but booking proceeds without permit; recurs.
Sessions over 5 minutes, more for slower/older users; slot lost at last step with no warning (WCAG 2.2.1), details kept; recurs per such session.
Cancelled bookings, reachable via the double-tap bug; red status line is visible in screenshot but h1 Booked and gate instructions contradict it; wasted trip risk.
Any double tap/Enter twice within 1.5 s, made likelier by no progress cue; booking silently cancelled, resident turned away at the gate.
Every completed booking; page kept for the gate lacks day/time/vehicle, workaround is memory or SMS; recurs each time consulted.
Van/trailer users with mistyped permit; late unlinked error after full form, recoverable via Change vehicle.
Keyboard users on every slot choice; no focus indicator at all on the main choice; not overcome by learning.
Residents whose plans change; requires a phone call in weekday hours (support contact). Departed from s=4 because a phone route exists and most changes are not time-critical.
Every day choice; blank for about 1 s. Departed from s=3: the delay is short and resolves on its own.
Phones 360 px and below; grid about 32 px wider than container, causing sideways scroll or clipping on the main choice.
Every day with Few left slots (screenshot: unheaded block above Morning incl. afternoon times); misreading the Morning grid as complete; times still printed.
Duplicate of the done-page content gap; every booking; arrival time not on the page kept for the gate.
Same split seen in screenshot; visual vs DOM order mismatch for keyboard/SR plus misgrouping for all; disorientation, not a block.
Every booking and day change; no visible progress for 1-1.5 s, which invites the second tap that cancels a booking (B-007 risk).
Only after a mistyped date following a search; inline error is clear; stale text is a small confusion.
Screen-reader users on every step; progress cue missing, not task-blocking.
Every day change; empty list under old date briefly. Departed from s=3: resolves in under a second.
Every booking; unchanged button for 1.3-1.5 s invites a second tap, which triggers the cancellation defect.
Same-day bookings (Today is default); full form filled then rejected with unlinked error.
Same-day bookings; past slot selectable, rejected only later (per B-011) so wasted effort rather than a gate turn-away.
Van/trailer residents without permit, once each; must search council site. Departed from s=1: it blocks a core task group from progressing and the 2-day delay is discovered late.
Forced-colours users only; aria-pressed and the date line restate the day.
Low-vision users and phone in poor light; 3.0:1 fails AA on an availability cue; the slot itself remains readable.
Design-token conformance issue; user harm is covered by the contrast finding, so effect here is trivial.
Landline-only residents (many older) cannot book at all; hint implies optional; recurs every attempt.
Residents who pause mid-booking; no notice of the hold leads to unexplained slot loss.
Residents adjusting waste at the last step; must guess Change vehicle; recoverable.
Every Change slot use; looks like a fresh booking but vehicle and waste are kept; uncertainty, not loss.
Same expired-hold message as B-005; Change slot visible in the row, details kept.
Every booking; memory load, confirm step shows the slot. Departed from s=3: mild uncertainty, easily verified one step later.
Everyone changing slot or going back; resets to Today, risking a booking on the wrong day.
